Name: Trees drop ores
Author: LyzzCL
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simple content patcher mod that makes wild trees drop ores depending on foraging level. It has been balanced with vanilla in mind so if you use mods it will work without issues but the more trees there are in the wild the more ores you will get (for example SVE adds a forest with tons of trees you can use to farm ores).[/color][/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Drang an drop the folder to your Mods directory.[/color][/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color]
Chance of drop ores increase with foraging level:
[list]
[*]Level 0-2: Copper Ore (10% Chance)[/*]
[*]Level 3-5: Copper/Iron (25% Chance)[/*]
[*]Level 6-8: Copper/Iron + Gold (50% Chance + 15%)[/*]
[*]Level 9: Copper/Iron + Gold (75% Chance + 30%)[/*]
[*]Level 10: Copper/Iron + Gold + Iridium (75% Chance + 30% + 10%)[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Ironwood Trees
Manifest.Description: Trees outside the farm can drop ores.
